dog.description_text:
Meet Reagan, a 10 yr old, 20 pound, wonderful Westie mix. He is friendly and gets along with other dogs well!

These pups are part of a hoarding case PupStarz Rescue is helping with. While many are adjusting well, they may need a little extra time, patience, and understanding as they settle into their new lives.

If you would like to adopt this dog, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
